description: This file contains the implementation of the 'find' and 'replace' dialog for CKEditor, including functions for text search, highlighting, and replacement within the editor.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.walker
classes.description: A class for traversing DOM nodes within the CKEditor environment.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.range
classes.description: A class representing a range of text or DOM nodes within the editor.

methods.name: a
methods.description: Checks if a node is a non-empty text node.

methods.name: b
methods.description: Determines if a node is not a block boundary or non-editable element.

methods.name: c
methods.description: Returns an object with details about the current text node and cursor position.

methods.name: f
methods.description: Synchronizes the find and replace input fields based on the selected tab.
